name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text:
Do this: Run PR-Agent in parallel mode on *all PRs* but *flag* new contributors’ feedback for human review.

Reason: Parallel mode speeds up the pipeline by processing feedback concurrently, while flagging new contributors’ input ensures quality without overloading reviewers. Trade-off: Slower feedback for experienced contributors to catch edge cases.

name: Gauge
text: The real risk isn’t just slower false-positive detection—it’s training the team to ignore *all* automated feedback because new contributors’ flags dilute the signal. Better alternative: run PR-Agent in parallel mode *only* for established contributors, while routing new contributors’ PRs to a human reviewer first. Settle it by testing both approaches on a sample of PRs and measuring reviewer satisfaction and error rates.
